warnings: Upper stair flight: from the ชานพัก (half-landing) up to ระดับพื้นชั้น 2. The lower flight is on S-16/หน้า43; the conventions described in that file's warnings (bar_layers rather than a single main_bar, 'ทุกมุม' left without a pitch, RB/DB assignment, no flight width dimensioned) apply here unchanged.
Geometry: 8 risers @0.175 = 1.40m rise, 7 treads @0.25 = 1.75m going, landing 1.20m, 2.95m overall horizontally. Waist 0.125m, landing 0.30m thick.

The two flights share the same 0.175 riser and 0.25 tread, so the storey height works out at 18 risers x 0.175 = 3.15m from floor 1 to floor 2. That is consistent but is NOT printed anywhere — this house's structural set gives no floor-level table (see the grid master's z_levels warning), so it is recorded here as a note rather than added as a z-level.
Both ends of this flight frame into a B2: the landing end and the floor-2 end. No column is drawn on this sheet.
Bar lengths printed along the slope on this flight are 0.70 and 0.80 (off the upper end) and 0.40 (off the landing).
